sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We targeted the TP53 locus in Homo sapiens (GRCh38) using SpCas9. The guide RNA sequence was AATTCCCGTCGCTATCAAGG. The PAM motif was NGG. Lipofection delivered the plasmid into HeLa cells (RRID:CVCL_0030). A scrambled control was included. Editing was measured by Sanger sequencing (n = 3). Off-target analysis used CRISPOR. Guides were designed with CRISPOR.
